objective: Verify and, only where a fresh baseline finds a gap, improve one representative daily-report reading path so readers identify the finding, evidence limits and next check.

checks.description: Independent review of scoped artifacts, relevant focused behavior checks and Human acceptance; execution evidence recorded at implementation time.

acceptance.description: Recheck the current four representative states, retain a baseline and have Human select a Designer/Trader-reviewed bounded layout or accept an evidence-backed no-code outcome.

Essential instrument information fits 390px without horizontal document scrolling; observations, interpretations, forecasts and Unrated states remain distinct, with material limits adjacent and full provenance accessible.
Verify keyboard/focus/disclosure/filter/report-date/history behavior and unchanged financial values using relevant existing checks; replay frozen summary-fidelity examples where applicable.

Record reader tasks, participant count, completion and misinterpretations for finding, Unrated meaning, source time and next check, and deliver actual preview/evidence/limitations for Human acceptance; claim no measured lift without a comparable baseline.
